brief:
Israeli occupation forces demolished an inhabited house and arrested a resident in the village of al-Walaja, near Bethlehem, the Ma'an news agency reported. The operation targeted a civilian home in the Palestinian community.

The demolition and arrest marked the latest in a series of such operations in the area. Al-Walaja, situated between Bethlehem and Jerusalem, has faced repeated Israeli military incursions and home demolitions.
title: Israeli forces demolish inhabited home, arrest resident in Bethlehem village
